meta.title: Top 100 Fitness Retreats & Wellness Resorts 2026
meta.subtitle: The world's best places to book a stay and train — ranked. Transformation camps, longevity clinics, sport meccas, and the resorts where fitness is the point of the trip.

scoreModel.name: Retreat Influence Score
scoreModel.gate: Bookable stays with a genuine fitness or movement program only — no pure spas or beauty clinics. Training camps and wellness resorts are scored on the same scale.
scoreModel.notes: Reach is log-scaled and recomputed from each property's researched follower counts. The five judgment factors — program, prestige, facility, setting, results — are calibrated across research segments so no category is scored on an easier curve. Counts marked verified were browser-checked at the listed date; the rest are approximate.

meta.disclaimer: Details are editorial estimates (2026) and the ranking is reviewed monthly. Inclusion is not an endorsement; programs, prices, and properties change — check before you book.

entries.name: Club La Santa
entries.who: Self-contained multisport campus on Lanzarote's lava coast, with stays from a few days to several weeks and full swim/bike/run infrastructure.
entries.why: The original multisport training mecca, running since 1979 and the home base of IRONMAN Lanzarote.
entries.takeaway: Book it as a training block, not a holiday — bring a plan for the swim, bike, run.

entries.name: Sensei Lanai, A Four Seasons Resort
entries.who: Larry Ellison-backed science-driven retreat pairing personal Sensei guides with movement, nutrition, and sleep programs, from ~$2,500/night.
entries.why: The most heavily funded new wellness-resort concept of the last decade, co-run with Four Seasons on a private Hawaiian island.
entries.takeaway: Come for a personally guided science program on a private island — this suits data-driven wellness travelers, not beach loungers.

entries.name: Tiger Muay Thai
entries.who: Stay-and-train Muay Thai/MMA camp with 150+ classes a week across fitness, yoga, BJJ, strength & conditioning and beach bootcamps; dorm rooms from ~6,000 baht/month up to bungalows.
entries.why: The largest and most internationally recognized combat-sports training camp in the world, drawing fighters and fitness travelers from every continent year-round.
entries.takeaway: Go if you want to train like a fighter — 150+ weekly classes suit committed combat-sports travelers, not casual gym-goers.

entries.name: SHA Wellness Clinic
entries.who: Oceanfront medical-wellness flagship, 4-21 night stays, macrobiotic cuisine and full diagnostic medicine; from ~$900/night.
entries.why: The clinic most other medical resorts get compared to; pioneered the integrative-medicine-plus-fitness format in Europe.
entries.takeaway: Come for the diagnostics and leave with a protocol — this is medicine with a resort attached.

entries.name: Clinique La Prairie
entries.who: Lake Geneva longevity clinic operating since 1931, revitalization and cellular-therapy programs plus a full fitness and movement wing; from ~$1,500/night.
entries.why: The longest-running name in medical longevity tourism; near-century of celebrity clientele and press.
entries.takeaway: Book this for clinical longevity treatments and cellular therapy, with fitness support alongside — not a standard spa weekend.

entries.name: Canyon Ranch Tucson
entries.who: Original destination-spa resort on a 150-acre Sonoran desert campus, all-inclusive stays from ~$1,200/night.
entries.why: The property that invented the modern destination spa in 1979; Michelin Guide gave it its top Three Keys honor in 2025.
entries.takeaway: The original destination-spa format — go for the full all-inclusive desert-campus experience, not a quick fitness fix.

entries.name: Kamalaya Koh Samui
entries.who: Wellness sanctuary built around a former monk's cave; week-long detox, burnout, and fitness programs led by an in-house team of doctors, TCM practitioners, and trainers.
entries.why: Regularly ranked among the world's top wellness resorts by Conde Nast and Travel+Leisure.
entries.takeaway: Book a week-long program with doctors and TCM practitioners for detox or burnout recovery — not a beach-only holiday.

entries.name: Lanserhof Tegernsee
entries.who: Modernist medical health resort built around the Lanserhof/F.X. Mayr cure, with in-house physicians and diagnostics; from ~$1,100/night.
entries.why: Widely cited as the benchmark European medical spa; the architecture and Mayr-cure protocol both get copied.
entries.reach: IG ~112K brand-wide @lanserhof (verified 2026-08, no site-specific handle found)
entries.takeaway: Come for the Mayr-cure medical protocol under physician supervision, not a leisure spa break.

entries.name: Palazzo Fiuggi
entries.who: Early-1900s palace near Rome converted in 2021 into a high-tech longevity clinic with full diagnostics, gym, and Pilates/yoga studios; from ~$1,300/night.
entries.why: Fastest-rising name in medical wellness; Oprah's publicly named favorite and a 2025 Condé Nast Best Destination Spa winner.
entries.takeaway: Book it for high-tech longevity diagnostics with movement studios attached — a clinic stay, not a palace vacation.

entries.name: Surf Simply
entries.who: All-inclusive boutique surf-coaching resort; week-long stays built entirely around technical, video-analyzed surf instruction, from about $4,000/week.
entries.why: Pioneered systemized surf coaching and is the most media-covered dedicated surf-coaching resort (NYT, Conde Nast, WSJ, CNN).
entries.takeaway: Go to get coached on your surfing with video analysis — a technical surf school, not a surf-and-relax trip.

entries.name: Rancho La Puerta
entries.who: 80-plus-year-old fitness ranch on a mountain estate with six gyms, dozens of daily classes, and an organic farm, from ~$650/night all-inclusive.
entries.why: The oldest destination fitness resort in the Americas and a direct model for Golden Door and Canyon Ranch.
entries.takeaway: Book it for a classic all-inclusive fitness-ranch week — six gyms and daily classes, not a passive spa stay.

entries.name: Chiva-Som International Health Resorts
entries.who: Beachfront medical-wellness resort; 3-14 night programs pairing naturopathy and spa with daily fitness classes and personal training, from ~$700/night.
entries.why: Opened in 1995 and set the template the modern destination-wellness-resort category still follows.
entries.takeaway: Come for naturopathy plus daily fitness and personal training by the beach — wellness structure, not a party resort.

entries.name: Ananda in the Himalayas
entries.who: Wellness resort inside a former Maharaja's palace estate in the Himalayan foothills; Ayurveda, yoga, and structured fitness or weight-management programs of 5-14 nights.
entries.why: 25 years running as India's flagship destination-wellness address, with repeat #1 finishes in global spa-resort rankings.
entries.takeaway: Book a 5-to-14-night Ayurveda and weight-management program in the Himalayan foothills — not a quick palace sightseeing stop.

entries.name: The Farm at San Benito
entries.who: Medical-wellness resort south of Manila; multi-day fasting, detox, and fitness programs under physician supervision, from ~$400/night.
entries.why: Southeast Asia's best-known medical-wellness address, a magnet for regional celebrities and executives.
entries.takeaway: Go for a physician-supervised fasting or detox program, not a casual tropical getaway.

entries.name: Euphoria Retreat
entries.who: Destination spa retreat in the Peloponnese running 4-14 night holistic programs (yoga, Pilates, TCM, detox); from ~$800/night.
entries.why: The most awarded and widely covered wellness retreat in Greece, seen as continental Europe's holistic benchmark.
entries.takeaway: Book a 4-to-14-night holistic program of yoga, Pilates, TCM and detox — Europe's benchmark, not a beach holiday.

entries.name: Lanserhof Sylt
entries.who: Lanserhof's newer North Sea-island outpost, dune-set architecture and the same medical Mayr-cure program; from ~$1,100/night.
entries.why: Extends the Lanserhof standard to Germany's most exclusive island resort market.
entries.reach: IG ~112K brand-wide @lanserhof (verified 2026-08, no site-specific handle found)
entries.takeaway: Come for the same medical Mayr-cure protocol as Lanserhof's flagship, in a dune-set island setting — not a beach vacation.

entries.name: The Ranch Malibu
entries.who: 4- and 7-night residential retreat: 4-6 hours of coached daily hiking, plant-based meals, no phones, capped at 20-24 guests; from ~$1,200/night.
entries.why: The benchmark hiking-based transformation retreat since 2010; the format every later hiking bootcamp on this list copies, with a long, quiet celebrity guest history.
entries.takeaway: Book 4 or 7 nights of daily coached hiking, no phones — a hard reset, not a relaxing spa stay.

entries.name: Chenot Palace Weggis
entries.who: Lake Lucerne palace hotel running the Chenot Method detox and diagnostics program in a 5,000 sqm medical spa; from ~$1,000/night.
entries.why: Henri Chenot's original detox methodology, now franchised worldwide, still headquarters here.
entries.takeaway: Come for the original Chenot Method detox and diagnostics program, not just a lakeside palace stay.

entries.name: Playitas Resort
entries.who: All-inclusive sports resort built around a multisport complex; week-long triathlon, athletics, and team-sport camps for pros and amateurs.
entries.why: Voted among Europe's top triathlon training centres by pro athletes and coaches; hosts national federations year-round.
entries.takeaway: Book a week-long triathlon or team-sport training camp here — pros and amateurs both train, not lounge.

entries.name: Miraval Arizona
entries.who: Mindfulness-and-movement resort (zip line, equine therapy, fitness classes) that popularized the wellness-resort format for a celebrity clientele.
entries.why: One of the most media-covered US wellness resorts of the past two decades; spawned sister properties nationwide.
entries.reach: IG 98K (verified 2026-08, @miravalresorts brand account covers all locations)
entries.takeaway: Go for mindfulness-and-movement activities like equine therapy and zip lining, not a straight fitness camp.

entries.name: Golden Door
entries.who: Ultra-exclusive fitness-and-spa retreat capped at around a dozen guests a week, from ~$1,600/night.
entries.why: The benchmark for boutique luxury fitness retreats since 1958; still the model other high-end resorts imitate.
entries.takeaway: Book this for an ultra-small-group fitness-and-spa week — the original boutique luxury retreat, not a large resort.

entries.name: Amanpuri
entries.who: Original Aman flagship resort; Holistic Wellness Centre runs multi-day wellness immersions of Pilates, Muay Thai, yoga, and beach bootcamps alongside standard resort stays, from ~$1,500/night.
entries.why: The property that popularized ultra-luxury resort wellness across Asia and remains the category's aspirational benchmark.
entries.takeaway: Book a multi-day wellness immersion of Pilates, Muay Thai and yoga alongside a standard luxury stay — not fitness-only.

entries.name: IMG Academy
entries.who: Multi-sport athletic campus running adult and family performance camps across 11 sports nearly every week of the year, with discounted stays at the on-site Legacy Hotel.
entries.why: The most recognized sports-performance brand in the US, built on decades of producing pro and Olympic athletes.
entries.takeaway: Book a performance camp in one of 11 sports, not a leisure stay — the hotel is a bonus.

entries.name: Chable Yucatan
entries.who: Ultra-luxury jungle resort built around a cenote, with a longevity clinic and fitness program, from ~$1,200/night.
entries.why: Named to The World's 50 Best Hotels list in 2025, giving it outsized prestige for a wellness-focused property.
entries.takeaway: Come for the longevity clinic and cenote setting together — a luxury jungle stay with real fitness programming.

entries.name: Kurotel
entries.who: Medical longevity center and spa with personal training, Pilates, aquatic fitness, and morning hikes alongside clinical diagnostics, from ~$700/night.
entries.why: Elected Best Spa of the Americas; over 40 years of medical-grade longevity and integrative-health programming.
entries.takeaway: Book this for clinical diagnostics paired with daily personal training and hikes — medical longevity, not a leisure spa.

entries.name: COMO Shambhala Estate
entries.who: Rainforest wellness estate above the Ayung River; multi-day programs combining yoga, personal training, and Ayurvedic/TCM consultations in private villas, from ~$900/night.
entries.why: One of the properties that defined Bali wellness luxury in the 2000s and still draws repeat A-list guests.
entries.takeaway: Book a private-villa program mixing yoga, personal training and Ayurvedic consultations — luxury wellness, not a party retreat.

entries.name: Grantley Hall (ELITE Gym)
entries.who: Yorkshire country-house hotel built around the ELITE performance gym: personal training, cryotherapy and half/full-day fitness experiences; from ~$600/night.
entries.why: Widely covered as the UK's most serious hotel gym, pairing five-star hospitality with genuine strength-and-conditioning depth.
entries.takeaway: Book it for serious strength-and-conditioning and cryotherapy inside a country-house hotel — not a spa-only weekend.

entries.name: SIRO One Za'abeel
entries.who: Dubai's first purpose-built fitness-and-recovery hotel, with biometric onboarding, cryotherapy and a science-based training program; from ~$500/night.
entries.why: Kerzner's 2024 launch was covered globally as a new hotel category: fitness and recovery as the entire guest journey, not an add-on.
entries.takeaway: Stay here for a fully science-based fitness-and-recovery program built into every part of the hotel, not an add-on.

entries.name: The BodyHoliday
entries.who: All-inclusive Caribbean fitness resort with a structured daily sport program (gym, watersports, personal training) built into the room rate, from ~$700/night.
entries.why: The Caribbean's original and best-known fitness-first resort, running the same all-inclusive training model for over 40 years.
entries.takeaway: Book it for a structured daily sport program built into the price — fitness-first, not a standard Caribbean all-inclusive.

entries.name: Six Senses Vana
entries.who: Long-running wellness retreat (est. 2014) folded into the Six Senses portfolio in 2023 under its original owner; multi-week Ayurveda, yoga, and fitness immersions.
entries.why: One of the few India retreats with genuine medical/Ayurveda depth, now backed by a global luxury-wellness brand's distribution.
entries.warning: Rebranded from independent 'Vana' to 'Six Senses Vana' in 2023; same owner and team.
entries.takeaway: Book a multi-week Ayurveda and fitness immersion here — genuine medical depth, now with global-brand resources behind it.

entries.name: Aro Ha Wellness Retreat
entries.who: Adventure-fitness retreat in the Southern Alps; 4-7 night programs of daily hiking, HIIT, and yoga with plant-based meals, for small groups of about 20.
entries.why: The reference 'get fit in nature' retreat of the Southern Hemisphere, repeatedly named New Zealand's top wellness address.
entries.takeaway: Book 4 to 7 nights of daily hiking, HIIT and yoga in small groups — nature fitness, not sightseeing.

entries.name: SHA Mexico
entries.who: SHA's Caribbean sister clinic on a private beach, same integrative-medicine method as the Spain original; from ~$900/night.
entries.why: Brings the SHA method to the Americas with a beachfront setting the Spain original lacks.
entries.takeaway: Come for the same SHA integrative-medicine method as Spain, now with a Caribbean beach attached.

entries.name: Sensei Porcupine Creek
entries.who: Sensei's desert retreat on Larry Ellison's former estate, 22 rooms, golf, tennis and evidence-based wellness programming; from ~$2,000/night.
entries.why: Confirmed open and operating in 2026; expands the Sensei method into the Palm Springs desert wellness market.
entries.takeaway: Book this for the Sensei evidence-based wellness program on a small, private desert estate — not a golf getaway.

entries.name: VIVAMAYR Maria Wörth
entries.who: Lakeside medical health resort built on F.X. Mayr digestive medicine, with full diagnostics, movement and nutrition coaching; from ~$700/night.
entries.why: One of the two flagship VIVAMAYR sites that popularized the Mayr cure internationally.
entries.takeaway: Come for the Mayr-cure digestive protocol with full diagnostics — medical resort, not a lakeside holiday.

entries.name: Buchinger Wilhelmi
entries.who: The original medically supervised therapeutic-fasting clinic, running since the 1920s, with daily movement and physician oversight; from ~$500/night.
entries.why: The clinic that invented modern medical fasting; still the most cited name in fasting research and longevity press.
entries.takeaway: Book a medically supervised fasting stay with physician oversight — this is the original fasting clinic, not a diet retreat.

entries.name: Gwinganna Lifestyle Retreat
entries.who: Hilltop lifestyle retreat above the Gold Coast; 4-10 night stays built around daily bootcamp-style training, yoga, and health-coaching seminars, with microbiome testing added for 2026.
entries.why: Australia's longest-running fitness-forward wellness retreat, long favored by local executives and celebrities.
entries.takeaway: Book 4 to 10 nights of daily bootcamp training and health coaching plus microbiome testing — not a passive escape.

entries.name: Six Senses Ibiza
entries.who: Cliffside wellness resort on Ibiza's northern tip with an Alchemy Bar biohacking lab, fitness classes and longevity diagnostics; from ~$700/night.
entries.why: Six Senses' flagship European biohacking property, blending measurable diagnostics with resort-level design and setting.
entries.takeaway: Come for biohacking diagnostics at the Alchemy Bar alongside fitness classes — measurable wellness, not just island resort time.

entries.name: RAKxa Integrative Wellness
entries.who: Riverside medical-wellness retreat blending Western diagnostics with Ayurveda, Traditional Chinese and Thai medicine, plus fitness and movement studios; from ~$600/night.
entries.why: Thailand's leading medical-integrative resort, from the founders of Chiva-Som, and a fast-growing regional benchmark.
entries.takeaway: Book this for blended Western diagnostics and Ayurvedic/TCM medicine with structured movement — medical-integrative, not a spa trip.

entries.name: Joali Being
entries.who: A private Maldivian island fully dedicated to well-living rather than à la carte spa, with personalised Mind/Skin/Microbiome/Energy programmes and daily movement; from ~$2,000/night.
entries.why: The first Maldives resort built entirely around structured wellbeing science rather than beach-and-spa leisure.
entries.takeaway: Book a personalized wellbeing-science programme here — structured, not a beach-and-spa island holiday.

entries.name: explora
entries.who: Adventure-fitness lodges with graded daily guided hiking, trekking, and biking excursions across Chile's most extreme landscapes.
entries.why: The benchmark adventure-lodge operator in South America, multi-award-winning across nine lodges in four countries.
entries.takeaway: Book this for graded daily guided hikes across extreme landscapes — adventure fitness, not a lodge-and-relax trip.

entries.name: The Body Camp
entries.who: 7-, 14-night and multi-week bootcamp in a rustic Ibizan countryside villa: boxing, circuits, TRX, hikes, ice baths, plant-forward meals; returned to Ibiza for 2026-2027 after runs in Mallorca.
entries.why: Entering its 11th year under coach Ricki Parcell, one of Europe's longest-running transformation bootcamp brands, with a large following built on visible client results.
entries.takeaway: Book a multi-week bootcamp of boxing, circuits and ice baths under a named coach — transformation, not a villa holiday.

entries.name: Lefay Resort & SPA Lago di Garda
entries.who: Hillside wellness resort above Lake Garda with a 4,300-square-meter spa temple and movement, TCM and detox programs; from ~$500/night.
entries.why: Repeat Conde Nast Traveller and World Spa Award winner, ranked among Europe's top wellness architecture and programming.
entries.takeaway: Book it for TCM and detox programming inside an award-winning spa temple — programmed wellness, not a lakeside villa week.

entries.name: Zulal Wellness Resort by Chiva-Som
entries.who: The Middle East's largest immersive medical wellness resort, gender-segregated wings, full diagnostics and structured movement programs; from ~$800/night.
entries.why: Qatar's flagship wellness investment and the region's biggest medical-resort infrastructure play.
entries.takeaway: Book this for full medical diagnostics and structured movement in gender-segregated wings — a medical resort, not a spa hotel.

entries.name: Mii amo
entries.who: Small luxury destination spa inside Enchantment Resort's red-rock canyon, with hiking, movement classes, and energy work.
entries.why: One of the most photographed wellness settings in the US, repeatedly ranked among the world's top spas.
entries.takeaway: Come for canyon hiking and movement classes in a small, photogenic setting — a scenic spa retreat, not intensive training.

entries.name: Castle Hot Springs
entries.who: Historic geothermal-springs resort reopened in 2019, combining hiking and training with natural hot pools on a National Historic Landmark site.
entries.why: Arizona's oldest resort site, reborn as a design-forward wellness destination with a strong social following for its scale.
entries.takeaway: Book this for hiking and training paired with natural hot springs — active, not a passive soak.

entries.name: The Ranch Hudson Valley
entries.who: East Coast sister of The Ranch Malibu, opened 2024: same 4- to 7-night guided-hiking, plant-based, digital-detox format an hour from NYC.
entries.why: Extends The Ranch's proven hiking-retreat formula to the East Coast; fast becoming the default alternative for guests who can't get to Malibu.
entries.takeaway: Book the same guided-hiking, digital-detox format as Ranch Malibu, just an hour from NYC — not a leisurely upstate trip.

entries.name: The Ashram
entries.who: Week-long residential program in the Santa Monica Mountains: sunrise yoga, daily hiking, fitness sessions, massage and plant-based meals; also runs international editions in Mallorca and Japan.
entries.why: Founded more than 50 years ago and one of the earliest hiking-and-fitness retreats to attract a celebrity following (Cindy Crawford, Gwyneth Paltrow, Oprah have all attended).
entries.takeaway: Book a week of sunrise yoga, daily hiking and coached fitness — a demanding program, not a relaxed retreat.

entries.name: Verdura Resort
entries.who: Rocco Forte coastal resort in Sicily running multi-sport 'Academies with the Stars' clinics (golf, tennis, football, gymnastics) alongside three championship golf courses; from ~$700/night.
entries.why: Hosts pro tournaments (Sicilian Open, Rocco Forte Open) and pairs elite sport infrastructure with celebrity-coach clinics.
entries.takeaway: Book a celebrity-coached sport clinic here — golf, tennis, football or gymnastics — not a plain beach resort stay.

entries.name: Grand Resort Bad Ragaz
entries.who: 150-year-old thermal-water resort with an onsite medical clinic and rehab center alongside spa and golf; from ~$700/night.
entries.why: One of Europe's oldest medical-thermal resorts, still ranked among the continent's top medical wellness properties.
entries.takeaway: Come for medical clinic and rehab care alongside thermal water and golf — clinical, not purely a spa trip.

entries.name: Canyon Ranch Lenox
entries.who: Berkshires sister property to the Tucson flagship, same all-inclusive fitness-and-spa program in a forested New England setting.
entries.why: A long-running East Coast anchor for the Canyon Ranch brand, drawing on the same 45-year program pedigree.
entries.reach: IG ~8K (approx 2026, no dedicated account found; shares @canyonranch brand)
entries.takeaway: Book the same all-inclusive fitness-and-spa program as Canyon Ranch Tucson, in a forested New England setting instead.

entries.name: COMO Parrot Cay
entries.who: Private-island luxury resort with the COMO Shambhala wellness program: daily yoga and pilates, a full fitness center, and personal training, from ~$1,500/night.
entries.why: One of the Caribbean's most celebrated wellness private islands, with an award-winning in-house program.
entries.takeaway: Book it for the COMO Shambhala wellness program on a private Caribbean island — structured movement, not island lounging alone.

entries.name: Fivelements Retreat Bali
entries.who: Plant-based healing sanctuary on the Ayung River; multi-day raw-food, yoga, and movement retreats in bamboo architecture, from ~$500/night.
entries.why: A pioneer of Bali's plant-based, raw-food wellness scene with a devoted international following.
entries.takeaway: Book a raw-food, yoga and movement retreat in bamboo architecture — plant-based healing, not a standard Bali resort stay.

entries.name: Eden Health Retreat
entries.who: Rainforest health retreat on almost 400 acres in the Gold Coast hinterland; 3-14 night stays of daily fitness sessions, hikes, and health coaching.
entries.why: Billed as Australia's longest-running health retreat, with a large and loyal repeat-guest base.
entries.takeaway: Book 3 to 14 nights of daily fitness, hikes and health coaching in the rainforest — structured, not scenery alone.

entries.name: Forte Village Sports Academies
entries.who: Sprawling beachfront family resort in Sardinia running year-round tennis, football and multi-sport academies alongside standard holiday stays; from ~$250/night.
entries.why: Decades of Grand Slam-champion clinics and pro-coached junior camps make it one of Europe's original resort sports academies.
entries.takeaway: Book a pro-coached tennis, football or junior sport academy here — this is a family sport camp, not fitness-only.

entries.name: Six Senses Zighy Bay
entries.who: Omani beach-and-mountain resort reached by paragliding or 4x4, running tailored wellness programs (detox, sleep, immunity) alongside adventure activity; from ~$900/night.
entries.why: One of the most photographed resort arrivals in the world, with a wellness program that pairs adventure with genuine diagnostics.
entries.takeaway: Book a tailored detox, sleep or immunity program alongside adventure activity — real diagnostics, not just a dramatic arrival.

entries.name: VIVAMAYR Altaussee
entries.who: VIVAMAYR's smaller alpine-lake outpost, same Mayr-cure medical program in a quieter mountain setting; from ~$650/night.
entries.why: Extends the VIVAMAYR medical method to a second, more secluded Austrian lake location.
entries.reach: IG follower count not separately confirmed; brand-wide @vivamayr and @vivamayrmariawoerth verified 2026-08
entries.takeaway: Come for the same Mayr-cure protocol as VIVAMAYR's flagship, in a quieter, more secluded alpine setting.

entries.name: Thanyapura Sports Resort
entries.who: Multisport campus resort with an Olympic-standard pool, athletics track, and structured triathlon/running programs; stays from days to months.
entries.why: One of Asia's most established sport-science-backed training resorts, popular with pro triathletes overwintering in Thailand.
entries.takeaway: Book this for structured triathlon or running training on Olympic-standard facilities — training camp, not a leisure resort.

entries.name: Crowie's Kona Training Camp
entries.who: Multi-day triathlon training camp hosted at the Mauna Lani resort by three-time IRONMAN world champion Craig 'Crowie' Alexander, run on the Kona race course itself.
entries.why: Led by a Kona legend on the actual world-championship course, the highest-prestige short-stay triathlon camp tied to a single race.
entries.takeaway: Book this to train the actual Kona race course with a world-champion coach — a short, focused triathlon camp.

entries.name: Palmaia, The House of AiA
entries.who: All-inclusive jungle-beachfront wellness resort with daily yoga and fitness classes and plant-based dining, from ~$400/night.
entries.why: Built one of the largest social followings of any wellness resort in the world through highly shareable design and content.
entries.takeaway: Book this for daily yoga and fitness classes in a highly photogenic jungle-beach setting — social-media wellness, not intensive training.

entries.name: Mountain Trek Health Reset Retreat
entries.who: 6- to 7-night hiking-based health reset in a glass-front timber lodge on Kootenay Lake: daily guided hikes, functional fitness, yoga, therapeutic massage, chef-prepared meals.
entries.why: 35+ years and 10,000+ guests running Canada's most decorated hiking retreat, self-styled and widely cited as the #1 rated health retreat in Canada.
entries.takeaway: Book 6-7 nights of daily guided hikes and functional fitness by the lake — active reset, not a lodge holiday.

entries.name: Lake Austin Spa Resort
entries.who: Lakeside destination spa with daily fitness classes, yoga, and canoeing, styled as a relaxed Texas Hill Country retreat.
entries.why: A consistent top-10 US destination spa in Travel + Leisure and Conde Nast reader polls for over a decade.
entries.takeaway: Book this for a relaxed mix of fitness, yoga and canoeing on the lake — gentle, not an intense camp.

entries.name: Cal-a-Vie Health Spa
entries.who: European-village-style boutique fitness retreat near San Diego, with small groups, personal training, and hillside hiking.
entries.why: A long-running Southern California fitness-retreat fixture with a loyal repeat-guest base.
entries.takeaway: Book this for small-group personal training and hillside hiking near San Diego — boutique fitness, not a big resort.

entries.name: Komune Resort & Beach Club Keramas
entries.who: Surf-and-fitness resort on Bali's best right-hand reef break; daily STOTT Pilates, a recovery centre, and 'Art of Longevity' programming alongside surf coaching.
entries.why: Fused world-class surf access with structured daily training, drawing a global surf-fitness crowd.
entries.takeaway: Book this for daily Pilates and recovery work alongside serious surf coaching — surf-fitness combo, not surf-only.

entries.name: Amanoi
entries.who: Aman resort inside Nui Chua National Park; wellness immersions blend personal training, Pilates, and yoga with spa and hydrotherapy, from ~$1,300/night.
entries.why: Vietnam's answer to Amanpuri: an ultra-luxury Aman property with a genuinely structured wellness program rather than a spa menu alone.
entries.takeaway: Book a structured Pilates, yoga and personal-training immersion here — genuine wellness programming, not just a scenic Aman stay.

entries.name: Unit 27
entries.who: Original strength-and-conditioning box on Phuket's 'Fitness Street': CrossFit, Olympic lifting, team endurance events, women-only strength classes, military-influenced coaching.
entries.why: Founded the Phuket fitness-tourism scene that Titan and others later joined; still runs the island's benchmark CrossFit Open and monthly throwdown competitions.
entries.takeaway: Go for serious CrossFit and Olympic lifting with real competitions on the calendar — hardcore training, not a wellness retreat.

entries.name: Premier Fitness Camp
entries.who: Adult weight-loss camp based at the Omni La Costa Resort: 4-5 hours of daily coached training at 3:1-4:1 client-to-coach ratios, behavioral-health and nutrition education; ~$6,000/week all-inclusive.
entries.why: Leads its category on documented outcomes, citing UCSD-backed data on fat-loss-to-muscle-preservation ratios well above typical weight-loss-camp results.
entries.takeaway: Book this for closely coached weight loss with documented outcomes data — a results-driven camp, not a casual fitness week.

entries.name: Schloss Elmau
entries.who: Bavarian Alps luxury spa hideaway with a sports center, gym and Jivamukti yoga studio alongside its famous cultural and spa program; from ~$700/night.
entries.why: A globally recognized name (host of the 2015 and 2022 G7 summits) whose fitness offering rides alongside its cultural and spa prestige.
entries.takeaway: Come mainly for the cultural and spa prestige, with a gym and yoga studio as a secondary add-on.

entries.name: The Lodge at Woodloch
entries.who: Luxury destination spa on 500 wooded acres in the Poconos, with fitness classes, yoga, and guided hikes.
entries.why: A repeat top-ranked US destination spa in national travel-magazine reader surveys.
entries.takeaway: Book this for gentle fitness classes and guided hikes in the woods — a relaxing spa stay, not intensive training.

entries.name: Paradis Plage
entries.who: Eco-resort on Morocco's Atlantic coast combining three daily yoga sessions, an outdoor CrossFit area and Rip Curl surf coaching; from ~$250/night.
entries.why: Morocco's original surf-yoga-fitness resort, a genuine niche category leader since the mid-2000s.
entries.takeaway: Book this for daily yoga, CrossFit and surf coaching together — a genuine surf-fitness-yoga combo, not a beach lounge.

entries.name: Fairtex Training Center Pattaya
entries.who: Legacy Muay Thai/MMA/BJJ camp with on-site dorms to private rooms; day drop-ins to monthly all-inclusive packages, open six days a week since 1971.
entries.why: One of the sport's oldest and most fighter-decorated camps, having produced multiple Muay Thai champions under the Fairtex name.
entries.takeaway: Go here to train like a champion at a decades-old fight camp — for fighters, not for a scenic getaway.

entries.name: Vuokatti Sport
entries.who: Olympic training-center resort with a ski tunnel, biathlon range, and roller-ski tracks; hotel/apartment stays from about EUR 95/night full board.
entries.why: Scandinavia's benchmark winter-sport training base, used by World Cup ski and biathlon teams and open to public training camps.
entries.takeaway: Book this for Olympic-grade ski and biathlon training facilities — winter-sport camp, not a general ski holiday.

entries.name: The Retreat Costa Rica
entries.who: Mountain wellness resort and spa with a dedicated Fitness Reboot program, yoga shala, and a fitness club added in 2025.
entries.why: Ranked a top-10 destination spa in the world by Conde Nast Traveler readers, the strongest fitness-forward name in Costa Rica.
entries.takeaway: Book the Fitness Reboot program with the new fitness club and yoga shala — structured, not a plain mountain spa.

entries.name: Six Senses Douro Valley
entries.who: Vineyard-estate wellness resort above the Douro River with yoga, hiking and light fitness programming built around wine-country relaxation; from ~$500/night.
entries.why: One of Portugal's most photographed wellness properties, though its program leans toward relaxation more than structured training.
entries.takeaway: Book this for light yoga and hiking amid the vineyards — relaxation first, not a serious training program.

entries.name: Champneys Tring
entries.who: The original English health farm (opened 1925) with a full fitness studio, classes and membership gym alongside its spa; from ~$300/night.
entries.why: A century of history as Britain's first health resort, still running structured fitness classes rather than spa-only treatments.
entries.takeaway: Book this for real fitness classes and a proper gym, not just spa treatments — Britain's original health farm.

entries.name: HATC Iten
entries.who: Lornah Kiplagat's high-altitude running base at 2,400m, with a gym, 400m track, and 25m pool; open bookings for recreational-to-elite runners, capped at 35 guests.
entries.why: Founded by a five-time world champion; the best-known gateway into Kenya's Rift Valley running culture.
entries.reach: IG ~1.1K (verified 2026-08, official account; most guest volume comes through partner tour operators)
entries.takeaway: Book this to train at altitude on a legendary running base — any level runner, not a sightseeing trip.

entries.name: Centro de Alto Rendimiento Sierra Nevada
entries.who: Spain's national high-altitude training center at 2,320m, with a 50m pool and indoor/outdoor tracks; individuals and clubs book stays through specialist camp operators.
entries.why: The reference altitude base for Spanish and visiting international athletics, cycling, and swimming squads for decades.
entries.takeaway: Book this through a specialist camp operator for serious altitude training — an athlete's base, not a tourist stop.

entries.name: CIVANA Wellness Resort & Spa
entries.who: Newer desert wellness resort with movement studios, sound healing, and a dedicated fitness program alongside spa services.
entries.why: Has built an outsized social following fast for a young property, helping normalize the wellness-resort format for a broader audience.
entries.takeaway: Book this for movement studios and sound healing in the desert — approachable wellness, not intensive training.

entries.name: REVIVO Wellness Resort
entries.who: 18-suite wellness resort with a dedicated fitness center, hydrotherapy, and vitality programs; 3-10 night stays, from ~$450/night.
entries.why: One of Bali's newer purpose-built wellness resorts, designed around structured multi-day programs rather than a spa-hotel retrofit.
entries.takeaway: Book 3 to 10 nights of a purpose-built vitality program with hydrotherapy — structured wellness, not a converted spa hotel.

entries.name: Naad Wellness
entries.who: New-generation luxury Ayurveda and naturopathy retreat near Delhi; personalized multi-week healing programs including yoga, naturopathy, and fitness therapy.
entries.why: One of India's fastest-rising high-end wellness addresses, positioned to compete with Ananda and Six Senses Vana.
entries.takeaway: Book a personalized multi-week Ayurveda and naturopathy programme here — India's newest high-end healing address.

entries.name: 38 Degrees North
entries.who: 3- to 6-night boutique fitness retreats at five-star hotels (Aguas de Ibiza, Six Senses Ibiza), plus periodic London pop-ups; short-break format for fast fitness resets.
entries.why: Running since 2012 with a steady stream of UK wellness-industry awards (2025-2026), known for pairing serious daily training blocks with luxury hotel settings.
entries.takeaway: Book a short 3-to-6-night fitness reset at a luxury hotel — serious training blocks in a compressed break.

entries.name: Live In Fitness
entries.who: Residential weight-loss and body-transformation camp, 5-7 hours of daily coaching, customized meal plans and aftercare; from ~$3,490/week. Long-running Long Beach site also active; Hilton Head location closed.
entries.why: 29 years trusted by pro athletes and TV networks (Dr. Phil, The Doctors), with a celebrity client list including Jessica Biel, Chris Paul and Angela Bassett.
entries.takeaway: Book this for intensive coached weight-loss and body transformation with aftercare — a serious camp, not a light retreat.

entries.name: Preidlhof
entries.who: Adults-only alpine dolce-vita resort with a large spa, gym and movement studios above the fitness-hotel tier but below clinical-medical; from ~$600/night.
entries.why: One of South Tyrol's best-known luxury wellness names, though closer to a premium spa hotel than a medical clinic.
entries.takeaway: Book this for movement studios and spa in the Alps — premium spa comfort, not a medical program.

entries.name: Villa Stephanie at Brenners Park-Hotel & Spa
entries.who: The medical-spa wing of the historic Brenners Park hotel, offering health checks and body programs alongside a grand-hotel stay; from ~$700/night.
entries.why: A storied European spa-town address, though its Instagram presence and program now run under the main Brenners Park account.
entries.warning: Villa Stephanie's own Instagram account has been folded into the main Brenners Park-Hotel handle.
entries.takeaway: Book this for health checks and body programs within a grand historic hotel — medical wing, not standalone clinic.

entries.name: Zafiro Palace Alcudia
entries.who: 5-star cycling-dedicated hotel with 350-bike storage, workshop, rental fleet, and organized routes; multi-night stays for clubs and individuals.
entries.why: Mallorca's benchmark cycling hotel and an official IRONMAN Mallorca sponsor, drawing cycling clubs from across Europe each spring.
entries.takeaway: Book this as a cycling-focused hotel with bike storage and organized routes — for clubs and cyclists, not general travelers.

entries.name: Six Senses Botanique
entries.who: Mountain wellness retreat in Brazil's Serra da Mantiqueira, with tai chi, yoga, hiking, and a jungle gym alongside spa treatments.
entries.why: Brazil's best-known destination spa, recently absorbed into the global Six Senses brand, raising its profile further.
entries.takeaway: Book this for tai chi, yoga and mountain hiking alongside spa treatments — Brazil's leading destination-spa mix.

entries.name: Titan Fitness Camp
entries.who: All-inclusive outdoor fitness camp since 2013: boot camp circuits, obstacle courses, Hyrox training, cycling and yoga, plus a 'Work Train Travel' package for remote workers.
entries.why: A well-established Fitness Street anchor with the strongest facility build-out on the strip — indoor gym, pool, sauna, ice baths — for its price point.
entries.takeaway: Book this for Hyrox training and boot camp circuits with strong facilities — fitness camp, or work-and-train remote package.

entries.name: Elysia Wellness Retreat
entries.who: Boutique health retreat in Hunter Valley wine country under Minor Hotels; 3-7 night stays combining daily fitness classes, spa, and nutrition coaching.
entries.why: Descended from the original Golden Door health-retreat concept that introduced structured fitness retreats to Australia.
entries.warning: Rebranded from Golden Door Elysia after Minor Hotels acquired the property in 2019; same site, new brand.
entries.takeaway: Book 3-7 nights of daily fitness classes and nutrition coaching in wine country — structured, not a winery holiday.

entries.name: Amatara Welleisure Resort
entries.who: Cliffside 'welleisure' resort coining its own wellness-plus-leisure category; daily yoga, Muay Thai, and fitness classes alongside spa and detox menus.
entries.why: Regularly shortlisted at the Conde Nast Johansens Awards; a well-known mid-tier Phuket wellness address.
entries.takeaway: Book this for a mix of daily Muay Thai, yoga and spa detox — wellness-plus-leisure, not pure training.

entries.name: No1 Bootcamp
entries.city: North Norfolk coast (year-round); also Ibiza, St Tropez, Marrakech, Portugal
entries.who: Residential weight-loss and fitness camps, 15+ years running: 5-6 coached sessions a day, InBody body-composition scanning, chef-prepared meals; from ~£1,000/week.
entries.why: The best-known year-round UK fat camp, now a 4-country operation off the original Norfolk site; regular UK press coverage of client transformations.
entries.takeaway: Book this for heavily coached weight-loss with body-composition scanning — a serious fat camp, not a light fitness break.

entries.name: Hilton Head Health
entries.who: 45-year-old metabolic-health and weight-management retreat with daily coached movement classes and nutrition support.
entries.why: One of the oldest continuously operating fitness retreats in the US, still built around a structured, coach-led program.
entries.takeaway: Book this for coached metabolic-health and weight-management support — a long-established structured program, not a spa week.

entries.name: Marbella Club Wellness
entries.who: Historic beachfront club on Marbella's Golden Mile offering 1-7 night wellbeing, nutrition and fitness programs; from ~$600/night.
entries.why: The original 1954 Riviera-of-the-Med club, now running a dedicated Thalasso and fitness wing alongside its celebrity history.
entries.takeaway: Book 1 to 7 nights of Thalasso and fitness programming at a storied beach club — history plus structure.

entries.name: Puente Romano Tennis & Fitness Club
entries.who: Marbella beachfront resort with a 16-court tennis-and-padel club plus a full performance gym, open to hotel guests and members; from ~$450/night.
entries.why: RFET-affiliated and rated among southern Europe's best clubs, hosting professional tournaments and year-round coaching.
entries.takeaway: Book this for serious tennis or padel coaching at an RFET-affiliated club — a sport-club stay, not a beach lounge.

entries.name: Eat Sleep Cycle
entries.who: Cycling tour operator and bike hub running multi-day packaged camps (bike, hotel, guided rides) out of pro-cyclist territory near Girona.
entries.why: The best-known cycling-travel brand built around Girona's status as a pro-cyclist training hub.
entries.takeaway: Book a packaged cycling camp with guided rides in pro-cyclist territory — for riders, not general sightseers.

entries.name: Skyterra Wellness Retreat
entries.who: Small-group weight-loss and fitness retreat in the Blue Ridge Mountains, with coached daily training and hiking.
entries.why: One of the longer-running US medically informed fitness retreats, built around structured coaching rather than resort spa services.
entries.takeaway: Book this for small-group coached weight-loss training and hiking — medically informed structure, not resort spa services.

entries.name: Absolute Sanctuary
entries.who: Boutique wellness and longevity resort with a strong yoga-teacher-training and detox program calendar; 3-14 night stays.
entries.why: A long-standing Koh Samui yoga and detox specialist with an international teacher-training reputation.
entries.takeaway: Book a yoga-teacher-training or detox program here — a specialist yoga stay, not a general beach resort.

entries.name: Phuket Cleanse
entries.who: All-inclusive detox-and-fitness retreat in a garden villa compound: bootcamps, Muay Thai, strength sessions and yoga paired with plant-based nutrition, infrared sauna and ice baths.
entries.why: Fills the fitness-plus-detox niche in Phuket's crowded training-camp scene, with restorative facilities most pure bootcamps on the street don't offer.
entries.takeaway: Book this for bootcamp and Muay Thai training alongside detox and ice baths — training plus recovery, together.

entries.name: Ragdale Hall
entries.who: Leicestershire health hydro and spa with a dedicated fitness studio, classes and thermal spa circuit; from ~$300/night.
entries.why: One of the UK's most established health-hydro brands, with decades of repeat-guest loyalty and broad press coverage.
entries.takeaway: Book this for fitness classes plus a thermal spa circuit — a classic UK health hydro, not intensive training.

entries.name: Viva Blue & Spa (Playa de Muro)
entries.who: 4-star beach hotel that hosts week-long, coach-run triathlon training camps (25m pool, gym, quiet cycling roads) from about GBP 900/person.
entries.why: One of Mallorca's most established third-party triathlon-camp venues, booked season after season by UK training operators.
entries.reach: IG ~5K (approx 2026, hotel account; camp audience is carried mainly by tour operators)
entries.takeaway: Book this through a triathlon tour operator for a coach-run training week — camp first, beach hotel second.

entries.name: Boot Camp Marbella
entries.who: Year-round all-inclusive active holidays from a 4-star hotel base, training at Mike's Gym in Puerto Banus (ranked among Men's Health's top 10 world gyms) and on the Marbella Club beachfront.
entries.why: Distinct from New You/Prestige, this operator's headline draw is training access to a genuinely elite gym facility rather than a generic outdoor circuit.
entries.takeaway: Book this for access to a genuinely top-ranked gym, not a generic outdoor bootcamp circuit.

entries.name: Kasbah du Toubkal
entries.who: Berber-run hilltop ecolodge in the High Atlas Mountains running multi-day guided treks up Jbel Toubkal and a dedicated trekking lodge; from ~$150/night.
entries.why: North Africa's best-known trekking base, decades of expedition credibility and genuine physical demand rather than gym infrastructure.
entries.takeaway: Book this for a genuinely demanding multi-day trek up Jbel Toubkal — expedition fitness, not gym infrastructure.

bubblingUnder.name: Kandui Villas
bubblingUnder.who: Luxury surf resort and boat-accessible villas in the Mentawais, with optional paid surf coaching, video analysis, and theory sessions.
bubblingUnder.why: One of the most recognized names in Mentawai surf travel, sitting on some of Indonesia's most consistent reef breaks.
bubblingUnder.takeaway: Book this for optional paid surf coaching and video analysis on world-class reef breaks — surf-focused, coaching is extra.

bubblingUnder.name: Talise Fitness, Madinat Jumeirah
bubblingUnder.who: Fitness club within Dubai's Madinat Jumeirah resort offering HIIT, BodyPump, tennis and squash coaching plus InBody assessments; day and stay access.
bubblingUnder.why: A serious multi-sport club inside one of Dubai's most-visited resort complexes, though it functions as a hotel amenity rather than a dedicated retreat.
bubblingUnder.warning: Some directories list this specific location as rebranded to 'J Club' at the Mina A'Salam wing of Madinat Jumeirah; the Talise Fitness brand remains active elsewhere in Jumeirah's Dubai portfolio, but confirm the current name before booking.
bubblingUnder.takeaway: Drop in for HIIT, tennis or squash coaching as a resort amenity — not a dedicated fitness retreat.

bubblingUnder.name: RunningInKenya.com Kaptagat Camp
bubblingUnder.who: All-inclusive weekly running camps at 2,400m in Kaptagat — shared rooms, full board, structured altitude sessions plus optional safari add-ons.
bubblingUnder.why: Kaptagat is the training base of the NN Running Team and multiple world-record marathoners; these camps put recreational runners on the same roads.
bubblingUnder.takeaway: Book a week of structured altitude running on the roads elite marathoners train — for runners, safari is optional.

bubblingUnder.name: Alba Wellness Valley by Fusion
bubblingUnder.who: Hot-spring wellness valley outside Hue; multi-day programs pairing thermal-mineral therapy with daily fitness and yoga classes, from ~$250/night.
bubblingUnder.why: Vietnam's leading purpose-built wellness resort, repeatedly named the country's best upcountry property.
bubblingUnder.takeaway: Book this for thermal-mineral therapy paired with daily fitness and yoga — a purpose-built wellness valley.

bubblingUnder.name: Prestige Boot Camp
bubblingUnder.city: London, plus Portugal and Spain camps
bubblingUnder.who: Luxury weight-loss boot camp, established 2008, marketed as Europe's largest provider: intensive multi-session days aiming for 8-12 lbs lost per week.
bubblingUnder.why: Long-running, self-styled market leader in UK/European weight-loss boot camps, with a celebrity-fan page and steady Trustpilot review volume.
bubblingUnder.takeaway: Book this for aggressive, multi-session weight-loss days aiming for fast pound-per-week results — intensive, not gentle.

bubblingUnder.name: Soul & Surf
bubblingUnder.who: Boutique surf, yoga, and massage retreats across three countries; all-inclusive week-long stays from about GBP 156/night.
bubblingUnder.why: A long-running, design-forward surf-retreat brand with a loyal following and a strong European client base.
bubblingUnder.takeaway: Book a week of surf, yoga and massage across its multi-country locations — relaxed surf-retreat, not intensive training.

bubblingUnder.name: Berghotel Turlwand
bubblingUnder.who: Family-run mountain hotel at 1,750m in Austria's Nordic-ski showcase region, booking single athletes or whole training camps against 220km of groomed trails and a biathlon range.
bubblingUnder.why: The lodging anchor of Ramsau's international Nordic training center, used by cross-country and biathlon national teams and open to individual bookings.
bubblingUnder.takeaway: Book this as a Nordic-ski or biathlon training base with 220km of groomed trails — for athletes, not casual skiers.

bubblingUnder.name: Wildfitness
bubblingUnder.who: Movement-and-nature retreats built around natural-movement training, beach and bush workouts, and deep-rest programming; runs seasonal retreats across the UK, Europe and its original Kenyan coast base.
bubblingUnder.why: One of the original 'ancestral fitness' retreat brands (25 years running), predating the natural-movement trend it helped popularize.
bubblingUnder.takeaway: Book a seasonal retreat of natural-movement training and deep rest — ancestral fitness, not a gym camp.

bubblingUnder.name: Bikini Bootcamp
bubblingUnder.who: Women-only weeklong retreat at Amansala: beach walks, morning yoga, fitness classes, sculpting sessions, yin yoga and spa services, running continuously since the early 2000s.
bubblingUnder.why: One of the pioneer women's fitness-retreat brands that helped put Tulum on the wellness-travel map, still running multiple dated retreats every year.
bubblingUnder.takeaway: Book a women-only week of beach walks, sculpting and yin yoga — a longstanding format, not co-ed intensity.

bubblingUnder.name: Longevity Health & Wellness Hotel
bubblingUnder.who: Coastal Algarve hotel focused on longevity health checks, detox and fitness programming at a more accessible price point; from ~$350/night.
bubblingUnder.why: A smaller-scale entry point into medical-longevity tourism, more affordable than the Alpine and Swiss clinics.
bubblingUnder.takeaway: Book this for longevity health checks and detox at an accessible price — a budget entry to medical wellness.

bubblingUnder.name: Sante Wellness Retreat & Spa
bubblingUnder.who: Winelands wellness retreat near Paarl with a dedicated Fitness Boost program (cardio, weights, Pilates reformers) plus nutrition coaching; from ~$300/night.
bubblingUnder.why: One of the few Southern African properties with a genuinely structured fitness-and-nutrition program, not just spa treatments.
bubblingUnder.takeaway: Book the Fitness Boost program of cardio, weights and Pilates reformers — structured training in the winelands, not spa-only.

bubblingUnder.name: Chewton Glen
bubblingUnder.who: New Forest country-house hotel with a gym, fitness classes and treehouse suites alongside its spa; from ~$400/night.
bubblingUnder.why: A long-running, well-reviewed English resort where fitness is a minor pillar next to its spa and grounds.
bubblingUnder.takeaway: Book this mainly for the treehouse suites and spa — fitness classes are a minor add-on, not the point.

bubblingUnder.name: New You Boot Camp / New You Escapes
bubblingUnder.who: All-inclusive fitness holidays (rebranding under 'New You Escapes'), averaging ~6 hours of exercise a day; from ~£633/week.
bubblingUnder.why: One of the original 2000s-era UK boot-camp-holiday operators, still trading nearly two decades on, now spanning Spain and UK venues.
bubblingUnder.takeaway: Book this for around six hours of daily exercise at a budget weekly rate — volume-driven, not a boutique week.

bubblingUnder.name: Karkloof Safari Villas & Spa
bubblingUnder.who: Private game-reserve lodge in KwaZulu-Natal combining safari drives with yoga, tai chi and a large spa; from ~$400/night.
bubblingUnder.why: Billed as home to Africa's largest spa, it draws a loyal regional following pairing wildlife with light movement programming.
bubblingUnder.takeaway: Book this for safari drives paired with yoga and tai chi — wildlife-first, with light movement, not a training camp.

bubblingUnder.name: Northern Bootcamp
bubblingUnder.who: Family-run residential weight-loss boot camp at the Golden Hill Retreat on the Northumberland coast: boxing, circuits, dune runs, coasteering, plus a dedicated Military Prep course for armed-forces fitness tests.
bubblingUnder.why: A well-reviewed regional UK operator with a genuine niche — its Military Prep program specifically trains candidates for Royal Marine, Army, Navy and RAF fitness entry standards.
bubblingUnder.takeaway: Book the Military Prep course if you're training for armed-forces fitness tests — otherwise it's a regional boot camp.

bubblingUnder.name: PhuketFit
bubblingUnder.who: All-inclusive weight-loss and fitness bootcamp near Ya Nui Beach; 1-4 week programs of daily group training and calorie-controlled meals, from ~$150/night.
bubblingUnder.why: A budget-tier fixture of Phuket's fitness-camp scene, self-marketed as Thailand's #1 health and fitness retreat.
bubblingUnder.takeaway: Book this for budget-tier group training and calorie-controlled meals near the beach — cheap and cheerful, not premium.
